blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reliable uncertainty estimation is important across visual recognition tasks, providing information about the confidence and reliability of model predictions. Many uncertainty estimation methods obtain predictive diversity through mechanisms that can suppress intermediate features, perturb the input, or require substantial additional computation. Stochastic activation functions, where network units randomly select between multiple nonlinearities during a forward pass, have previously been used to improve optimization behavior, mitigate limitations of fixed ReLU activations, and increase output diversity. In this work, we reframe stochastic activation switching as a lightweight mechanism for uncertainty estimation. The proposed method samples between nonlinear activation functions, inducing predictive diversity while keeping intermediate feature pathways active. This enables uncertainty estimation from a single trained model without the training cost of ensembles, task-specific uncertainty heads, or architectural redesign. We evaluate the proposed approach across classification, semantic segmentation, and out-of-distribution detection using convolutional and transformer-based architectures on diverse datasets. Across these settings, stochastic activation switching improves uncertainty quality while preserving competitive primary-task performance, showing that stochastic nonlinearities provide an effective and information-preserving source of predictive variation for visual recognition.
blocks.zh: 可靠的不确定性估计在视觉识别任务中都很重要,它提供了有关模型预测的信心和可靠性的信息。 许多不确定性估计方法通过能够压制中间特征、扰动输入或需要大量额外计算的机制获得预测多样性。 Stochastic活化功能,即网络单元在前行行期间在多条非线性之间随机选择,之前曾被用来改进优化行为,减轻固定ReLU活化的限制,并增加输出多样性. 在这项工作中,我们重新塑造了可变活化的活化转换,作为不确定性估计的轻量级机制. 拟议的方法样本介于非线性活化函数之间,诱导预测多样性,同时保持中间特征路径活性. 这使得能够从单一的训练有素的模型中作出不确定性估计,而无需培训综艺节目、具体任务的不确定性主管或建筑重新设计的费用。 我们评估拟议的方法,包括分类、语义分解、分配外检测等,在各种数据集上采用以转录和变压器为基础的结构。 在整个这些设置中,活化活化切换提高了不确定性的质量,同时保持了竞争性的初级任务性能,表明活化非线性为视觉识别提供了有效和信息保存的预测变异源.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Deep neural networks (DNNs) [ Goodfellow et al.(2016)Goodfellow, Bengio, and
Courville ] have driven major advances in computer vision, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification [ Krizhevsky et al.(2012)Krizhevsky, Sutskever, and
Hinton ] , object detection [ Redmon et al.(2016)Redmon, Divvala, Girshick, and
Farhadi , Ren et al.(2015)Ren, He, Girshick, and
Sun ] , semantic segmentation, and dense prediction tasks [ Ronneberger et al.(2015)Ronneberger, Fischer, and
Brox , Minaee et al.(2021)Minaee, Boykov, Porikli, Plaza, Kehtarnavaz, and
Terzopoulos ] .
Despite this progress, vision models frequently produce overconfident and poorly calibrated predictions [ Guo et al.(2017)Guo, Pleiss, Sun, and Weinberger ] , even when confronted with ambiguous inputs, corrupted samples, or out-of-distribution data [ Hendrycks(2016) ] .
This inability to reliably “know what it does not know” remains an obstacle to deploying deep learning systems in real-world visual recognition pipelines, where overconfident errors can lead to unreliable downstream decisions.
Uncertainty estimation addresses this limitation by augmenting predictions with confidence measures that help identify unreliable outputs [ Kendall and Gal(2017) ] .
However, obtaining uncertainty estimates that are accurate, well-calibrated, computationally efficient, and compatible with modern architectures remains a challenging problem [ Abdar et al.(2021)Abdar, Pourpanah, Hussain, Rezazadegan, Liu,
Ghavamzadeh, Fieguth, Cao, Khosravi, Acharya, et al. ] .

blocks.en:
A common strategy for uncertainty estimation is to generate multiple predictions for the same input and measure their disagreement.
Deep ensembles [ Lakshminarayanan et al.(2017)Lakshminarayanan, Pritzel, and
Blundell ] achieve this by training multiple independent models and are often considered a strong baseline for predictive uncertainty.
However, training and storing multiple models is computationally expensive.
Single-model alternatives such as Monte Carlo dropout [ Gal and Ghahramani(2016) ] reduce this cost by injecting stochasticity into the network during inference.
Nevertheless, dropout-based methods obtain diversity by randomly suppressing features, which can disrupt information flow and degrade the intermediate representations required for accurate classification or dense prediction.
This trade-off motivates the need for uncertainty estimation mechanisms that can induce predictive diversity without disrupting learned feature representations.
blocks.zh:
不确定性估计的一个共同策略是对同样的投入产生多种预测并衡量它们的分歧.
深聚体[拉克什米纳赖亚南等 (2017年)
Blundell]通过培训多个独立模型来实现这一目标,并且常常被认为是预测不确定性的强基准.
但是,培训和储存多种模型在计算上费用高昂。
蒙特卡洛辍学[Gal和Ghahramani(2016年)]等单一模式的替代方案通过在推论期间向网络注入花样来降低这一成本。
然而,基于退学的方法通过随机压制特征获得多样性,这种特征会干扰信息流动并降低准确分类或密集预测所需的中间表示.
这种取舍促使人们需要不确定性估计机制,这种机制可以诱发预测多样性,同时又不干扰所学到的特征表述。

blocks.en:
Stochastic activation functions have previously been explored as a means to improve gradient flow, introduce regularization, and increase predictive diversity in deep networks.
Instead of using a fixed nonlinearity for each neuron or layer, stochastic activation methods allow activation units to randomly select from a predefined set of nonlinear functions during each forward pass.
Prior work has used this randomness to improve robustness, alleviate the dead-unit problem, and encourage more diverse network behavior [ Ersoy and Erkmen(2021) , Gulcehre et al.(2016)Gulcehre, Moczulski, Denil, and
Bengio , Xu et al.(2015)Xu, Wang, Chen, and Li ] .
However, these methods have primarily been studied from the perspective of optimization and regularization, rather than a mechanism for uncertainty estimation.

以前曾探索过斯多克活化功能,作为改善梯度流,引入正态化,并增加深层网络预测多样性的手段.
相对于每个神经元或分层使用固定的非线性,分层活化方法允许活化单位在每次前行时从预先定义的一组非线性函数中随机选择.
先前的工作利用了这种随机性来提高稳健性,缓解已死单位的问题,并鼓励了更加多样化的网络行为[Ersoy和Erkmen(2021),Gulcehre等 (2016) Gulcehre, Moczulski, Denil,以及
Bengio , 徐等 (2015) 徐, 王, 陈等 (编).
然而,这些方法主要是从优化和正规化的角度,而不是从不确定性估计的机制的角度来研究的.

blocks.en:
In this work, we reframe stochastic activation functions as a mechanism for uncertainty quantification.
Our main observation is that stochastic switching of nonlinearities can introduce useful predictive variation while preserving the flow of information through the network.
Rather than removing features, the method keeps intermediate representations available and perturbs the nonlinear transformation applied to them.
As a result, a single trained model can produce multiple plausible outputs without discarding intermediate information (Fig. 1 ).
This property is particularly relevant for image classification and semantic segmentation, where preserving semantic and spatial structure is important for reliable predictions.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们重新界定了可变活化功能,作为不确定性量化的机制。
我们的主要观察是,非线性的分层切换可以引入有用的预测变异,同时保留信息通过网络的流动.
该方法不是去除特征,而是保留中间表达,并干扰对其应用的非线性转换。
因此,经过培训的单一模型可以产生多种可信的产出,而不丢弃中间信息(图1)。
这种属性与图像分类和语义分解特别相干,其中保存语义和空间结构对于可靠的预测非常重要.

blocks.en:
We propose a simple framework for uncertainty estimation based on stochastic activation switching.
The method does not require training multiple models or substantially redesigning the underlying architecture.
In our experiments, we apply it to both convolutional networks and transformer-based [ Vaswani et al.(2017)Vaswani, Shazeer, Parmar, Uszkoreit, Jones, Gomez,
Kaiser, and Polosukhin ] vision models to evaluate its applicability across different model classes.
At inference time, repeated stochastic forward passes produce a distribution of predictions from a single set of learned weights, enabling uncertainty to be estimated from predictive disagreement.
Because the stochasticity is introduced through activation selection rather than feature removal, the proposed approach provides an efficient alternative to feature-masking methods while avoiding the computational burden of explicit ensembles.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个简单的框架,根据有条理的活化转换来估计不确定性。
这种方法不需要培训多种模式或对基本架构进行实质性重新设计。
在我们的实验中,它应用到革命网络和变压器上[瓦斯瓦尼等 (2017)瓦斯瓦尼,沙泽尔,帕尔马尔,乌斯克赖特,琼斯,戈麦斯,
Kaiser, 和 Polosukhin )的视觉模型来评价它在不同模型类别中的可适用性.
推论时,反复的有条不紊地前行传出一组所学的分量的预测,从而能够从预测性分歧中估算出不确定性。
由于通过活化选择而不是特征去除引入了花样相克性,所拟议的方法为特征相克方法提供了高效的替代,同时避免了显性相克的计算负担.

blocks.en: We evaluate the framework on classification and segmentation across diverse datasets, modalities, scales, and in- and out-of-distribution settings. We compare against common uncertainty baselines and analyze task performance and uncertainty quality, with ablations on stochastic activation and inference settings. Results show competitive predictive performance and strong uncertainty estimates from a single trained model.
blocks.zh: 我们评价不同数据集、模式、尺度以及分配内外环境的分类和分类框架。 我们比较共同的不确定性基线,分析任务性能和不确定性的质量,并分析关于斯图克活化和推论的假设。 结果表明,有竞争力的预测性业绩和单一训练有素的模型的强烈不确定性估计。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows: (i) We propose stochastic nonlinearities as a computationally efficient and information-preserving approach for uncertainty estimation in image classification and semantic segmentation. (ii) We show that the proposed single-model approach achieves competitive uncertainty calibration and predictive performance compared with commonly used uncertainty estimation baselines, while avoiding the cost of training multiple models. (iii) We conduct extensive experiments and ablation across small, medium, and large-scale datasets, different visual modalities, convolutional and transformer-family architectures, and both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下: (一)我们提出以有条理的非线性作为计算效率和信息保存方法,用于图像分类和语义分解中的不确定性估计. (二)我们显示,与常用的不确定性估计基线相比,拟议的单一模式方法实现了竞争性不确定性校正和预测性能,同时避免了培训多模式的成本. (三)我们进行广泛的实验和通融,跨越中小型,大型的数据集,不同的视觉模式,演化和变压器-家族建筑,以及分流和分流外设置.

blocks.en: 2.1 Uncertainty Estimation
blocks.zh: 2.1 不确定性估计

blocks.en:
Bayesian Neural Networks (BNNs) [ Blundell et al.(2015)Blundell, Cornebise, Kavukcuoglu, and
Wierstra ] model epistemic uncertainty through posterior distributions over network parameters, but approximate Bayesian inference is costly at scale.
Laplace approximations [ Daxberger et al.(2021)Daxberger, Kristiadi, Immer, Eschenhagen, Bauer,
and Hennig ] reduce this cost by approximating the posterior around a trained solution, though performance depends on the quality of the approximation and curvature estimate.
Lightweight probabilistic networks [ Gast and Roth(2018) ] instead propagate activation uncertainty using assumed density filtering, offering a more efficient alternative but relying on approximate distributional assumptions.

blocks.en:

Scaramuzza ] , it obtains diversity by randomly suppressing features, so each stochastic pass discards part of the learned representation rather than transforming the same information differently. Variants such as MC-DropConnect [ Mobiny et al.(2021)Mobiny, Yuan, Moulik, Garg, Wu, and
Van Nguyen ] , which stochastically masks network weights, Concrete Dropout [ Gal et al.(2017)Gal, Hron, and Kendall ] , which learns dropout rates, and R-drop [ Wu et al.(2021)Wu, Li, Wang, Meng, Qin, Chen, Zhang, Liu,
et al. ] , which uses auxiliary regularization, have also been proposed, but their uncertainty still comes from removing information rather than preserving and transforming it.

Blundell ] estimate uncertainty from disagreement among multiple independently trained networks.
While effective, their diversity comes at the cost of repeated training, storage, and inference, with the computational burden typically scaling with the number of ensemble members.
Efficiency-driven alternatives reduce this overhead by using fixed partially overlapping masks as in Masksembles [ Durasov et al.(2021)Durasov, Bagautdinov, Baque, and
Fua ] , training checkpoints [ Huang et al.(2017)Huang, Li, Pleiss, Liu, Hopcroft, and
Weinberger ] , low-rank parameter sharing [ Wen et al.(2020)Wen, Tran, and Ba ] , or multi-branch architectures [ Teerapittayanon et al.(2016)Teerapittayanon, McDanel, and
Kung ] , but fully independent ensembles often remain stronger in calibration and reliability [ Ovadia et al.(2019)Ovadia, Fertig, Ren, Nado, Sculley, Nowozin,
Dillon, Lakshminarayanan, and Snoek ] .

Other single-model methods estimate uncertainty through input or model perturbations at inference time.
Test-time augmentation (TTA) [ Wang et al.(2019)Wang, Li, Aertsen, Deprest, Ourselin, and
Vercauteren ] uses transformed inputs, but requires manually chosen augmentations and repeated inference.
Monte Carlo Batch Normalization [ Mukhoti et al.(2021)Mukhoti, Dokania, Torr, and Gal ] samples stochastic batch-normalization statistics, while iterative methods [ Durasov et al.(2024)Durasov, Oner, Donier, Le, and
Fua ] use repeated refinement or convergence behavior.
HCM [ Choi et al.(2026)Choi, Kim, Lee, jo, lee, and
Ahn ] provides a sampling-free alternative based on hyperspherical confidence, but depends on its geometric formulation and optimization.
These methods reduce the need for independently trained ensembles, but rely on input transformations, normalization noise, iterative refinement, or geometric constraints.

blocks.en: 2.2 Stochastic activations
blocks.zh: 2.2 斯多克活化

blocks.en:
Stochastic activations have traditionally been used for regularization, optimization, and, in recent work, generative diversity. Early forms, such as dropout [ Hinton et al.(2012)Hinton, Srivastava, Krizhevsky, Sutskever, and
Salakhutdinov ] , can be interpreted as stochastic activation mechanisms that prevent co-adaptation of features. For optimization, methods such as those proposed by [ Gulcehre et al.(2016)Gulcehre, Moczulski, Denil, and
Bengio ] address specific pathologies in ReLU networks, including the “dying ReLU” phenomenon [ Xu et al.(2015)Xu, Wang, Chen, and Li ] , by injecting controlled randomness to preserve gradient flow in saturated regions and improve convergence stability.
blocks.zh:
斯特克活化传统上用于规范化,优化,并在最近的工作中用于基因多样性. 早期的形式,如辍学[Hinton等人(2012年),Hinton, Srivastava, Krizhevsky, Sutskever,以及
Salakhutdinov],可以被解释为能防止特征共适应的活化机制. 为优化起见,采用的方法包括[Gulcehre等人(2016年),Gulcehre, Moczulski, Denil,和
Bengio]解决ReLU网络中的具体病理问题,包括"衰竭的ReLU"现象[徐等 (2015)徐,王,陈,李],通过注射可控随机性来保持饱和地段的梯度流并增强趋同稳定性.

blocks.en:
A related activation-based approach, Random Activation Functions (RAF) [ Stoyanova et al.(2023)Stoyanova, Ghandi, and
Tavakol ] , uses activation-function diversity for uncertainty estimation through an ensemble of independently trained models, each assigned a randomly selected activation function that remains fixed within that model. Predictive uncertainty is estimated from disagreement across the ensemble members. In contrast, our method dynamically samples activation choices within a single model during both training and inference. Our work therefore leverages stochastic activations explicitly for uncertainty estimation. By maintaining activation stochasticity during inference, a single model can generate a functionally diverse set of predictions, providing a measure of combined predictive uncertainty without feature masking or architectural duplication. Similar to MC-Dropout, this uncertainty is derived from disagreement across repeated stochastic forward passes and is not explicitly decomposed into separate epistemic and aleatoric components. This reframes stochastic activations not only as a training mechanism, but also as an efficient, information-preserving path to reliable uncertainty estimation.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Motivation
blocks.zh: 3.1 动机

blocks.en:
As discussed in the previous sections, existing uncertainty estimation methods often obtain predictive diversity by either suppressing features, training multiple models, perturbing the input, or introducing additional inference procedures.
These choices can make uncertainty estimation less information-preserving, computationally expensive, or dependent on design choices that must be tuned for each architecture and dataset.
Our goal is to obtain diverse predictions from a single trained model without removing intermediate features, duplicating the network, or introducing additional trainable parameters.
blocks.zh:
如前几节所讨论,现有的不确定性估计方法往往通过压制特征、培训多种模型、扰动输入或引入额外的推论程序而获得预测多样性。
这些选择可以使不确定性估计降低信息保存率,计算成本高,或者依赖于必须针对每个架构和数据集进行调制的设计选择.
我们的目标是从单一的训练有素的模型中获得不同的预测,而不去掉中间特征,复制网络,或者引入额外的可训练参数.

blocks.en:
We achieve this by replacing deterministic activation functions with stochastic nonlinearities.
Instead of assigning a fixed activation function to each unit, the network randomly switches between the backbone’s original activation and an alternative nonlinearity during each forward pass.
The model is trained with the same stochastic mechanism used at inference time, so the learned weights become robust to activation-level variation rather than treating it as a test-time perturbation only.
At test time, the weights are kept fixed and multiple stochastic forward passes are performed through the same model.
The resulting prediction variability is then used to estimate uncertainty.
blocks.zh:
我们通过用有条理的非线性取代决定性的激活功能来实现这一点。
网络没有给每个单元分配固定的活化功能,而是在主干线最初的活化与每次前行时的替代非线性之间随机切换.
该模型在训练时采用了推想时使用的同分相机机制,因此所学的重量会变得强大到能活化-电平相变,而不只是把它当作试时扰动.
在测试时,会固定重量,并通过同一种模式进行多段有花样的前行通行证.
由此产生的预测可变性随后被用来估计不确定性。

blocks.en:
This formulation introduces diversity through transformations rather than feature removal. Every activation pathway remains active, and stochasticity only changes how the intermediate signal is transformed. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , this leads to more structured uncertainty than feature masking when stochasticity is increased at inference time. Therefore, the network can sample different functional behaviors while preserving the information carried by its features.
The method does not require model-specific uncertainty heads, additional learnable parameters, or repeated model training, making it simple to apply across different classification and segmentation architectures.

该方法不需要模型特定的不确定性头,额外的可学习参数,或重复的模型训练,这使得在不同的分类和分块结构中应用变得简单.

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Uncertainty quality under test-time stress. The left panel shows the input, prediction, ground truth, and errors; the right panels compare uncertainty maps from stochastic activation switching and MC Dropout, with brighter values indicating higher uncertainty.
We increase stochasticity only at inference time to examine its effect on uncertainty.
MC Dropout removes intermediate features, causing uncertainty to spread broadly, whereas stochastic activation switching keeps feature pathways active and concentrates uncertainty near boundaries and prediction errors.
This supports our motivation that activation-level stochasticity can induce predictive diversity without disrupting intermediate representations.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the proposed stochastic activation switching framework across image segmentation and image classification tasks.
The experiments are designed to test whether the method provides reliable uncertainty estimates while maintaining competitive task performance across different domains, architectures, and distribution shifts.
For fair comparison, all methods are trained and evaluated using the same dataset splits, input resolution, batch size, preprocessing, augmentation pipeline, backbone architecture, and optimization schedule within each task, unless a baseline requires its standard uncertainty-specific modification.

为了进行公平比较,所有方法都使用相同的数据集分解,输入分辨率,批量大小,预处理,扩能管,骨干架构,以及每个任务内的优化时间表来训练和评价,除非一个基线需要其标准不确定性特定修改.

Overall. Stochastic activations improves uncertainty quality while maintaining competitive task performance across most settings, with MiniImageNet the main exception in.
The method performs well across visual domains and architectures, including U-Net, ResNet-style classifiers, and Swin Transformer V2.
These results support the main claim that useful predictive diversity can be obtained from a single trained model without changing the input, adding an uncertainty head, redesigning the architecture, or training multiple models.

blocks.en:
Granularity of Stochasticity. We compare layer-level, channel-level, and node-level stochastic activation sampling.
Layer-level sampling shares one activation choice across an entire layer, channel-level sampling shares one choice within each feature channel, and node-level sampling independently samples the activation at each unit.
As shown in Table 5 , although layer-level stochasticity gives the lowest ECE, node-level sampling provides the strongest overall trade-off across predictive performance and uncertainty quality, improving accuracy, NLL [ Guo et al.(2017)Guo, Pleiss, Sun, and Weinberger ] , and Brier score.
This indicates that injecting stochasticity at the most local scale creates richer functional diversity inside the network.
This micro-level variation improves predictive uncertainty estimation while reducing local activation co-adaptation.

如表5所示,虽然层层的分层性为欧洲经委会提供了最低的分层性,但节点级采样在预测性能和不确定性质量之间提供了最有力的整体取舍,提高了准确性,NLL [郭等 (2017)Guo, Pleiss, Sun, and Weinberger], 和 Brier 得分.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We reframe stochastic activation switching as an uncertainty estimation mechanism. Instead of relying on feature masking, input perturbations, or explicit ensembles, the method induces predictive diversity by sampling between nonlinear activation functions while keeping intermediate feature pathways active. Across classification, segmentation, and out-of-distribution detection experiments, the proposed approach improves uncertainty quality without degrading the main task performance, and remains effective across different visual domains and architectures. The results show that stochastic nonlinearities can provide a lightweight and information-preserving source of predictive variation from a single trained model, without requiring separate uncertainty heads or task-specific architectural redesign. A limitation is that the activation pair influences the trade-off between predictive performance and calibration, while repeated stochastic passes introduce additional inference cost. Future work can explore adaptive activation selection and more efficient sampling strategies to reduce inference overhead while preserving uncertainty estimation quality.

blocks.en: A Approach Overview

blocks.en:
Stochastic Activation Switching replaces each deterministic activation in the backbone during training and inference with a per-unit Bernoulli switch between the backbone’s native activation σ orig \sigma_{\mathrm{orig}} and a fixed alternative σ alt \sigma_{\mathrm{alt}} .
During training, a fresh activation configuration is sampled at every forward pass, and the network is optimized with the standard task loss, so that the learned weights become robust to activation-level variation rather than to a single fixed nonlinearity.
At inference time, the trained weights are kept fixed and T T stochastic forward passes are drawn from the same input; the empirical mean of the resulting predictions is used as the point estimate, and the empirical variance across passes is used as the uncertainty estimate.
Because every activation pathway remains active in all passes, stochasticity changes only the shape of the nonlinearity applied at each unit, without removing features from the intermediate representation.
This perturbation-without-removal property is the qualitative distinction from dropout-style mechanisms [ Gal and Ghahramani(2016) ] and the basis for the uncertainty estimator analyzed in Section C .

blocks.en: D Computational Cost and Timing Analysis
blocks.zh: D 计算成本和时间分析

blocks.en:
We analyze the computational cost of stochastic activation switching in terms of both training and inference time.
The analysis separates the overhead introduced by the stochastic activation mechanism itself from the cost of performing multiple stochastic forward passes.
blocks.zh:
我们从培训和推断时间的角度分析分解激活转换的计算成本。
分析将Stochtic活化机制本身引入的间接费用与执行多次Stochtic前行通行证的费用区分开来.

blocks.en:
All timings are measured on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU.
For CIFAR-10, training time corresponds to one training epoch and inference time corresponds to evaluation over the complete test set.
All methods use the same backbone and input setting.
Our method and MC Dropout use T = 5 T=5 stochastic forward passes, while Deep Ensembles use five independently trained models.
The reported times therefore capture the complete end-to-end cost of each uncertainty-estimation procedure rather than only the deterministic backbone execution.
blocks.zh:
所有计时均用单NVIDIA H100 GPU来测量.
对于CIFAR-10,培训时间相当于一个培训时代,推断时间相当于对整套测试集的评价.
所有方法都使用相同的主干和输入设置.
我们的方法和MC Dropout使用 T = 5 T = 5 stochastic front passers,而Deep Ensembles则使用五个独立训练的模型.
因此,所报告的时间记录了每个不确定性估算程序的完整端到端成本,而不仅仅是确定性骨干执行。

blocks.en:
To isolate the sampling overhead under the same architecture and input setting, we compare the deterministic model, MC Dropout, Deep Ensembles, and our method on CIFAR-10.
The deterministic model requires 40.05 ​ s 40.05\,\mathrm{s} for one training epoch and 2.83 ​ s 2.83\,\mathrm{s} for full test-set inference.
MC Dropout requires 40.97 ​ s 40.97\,\mathrm{s} and 13.66 ​ s 13.66\,\mathrm{s} , respectively, while our method requires 42.73 ± 0.36 ​ s 42.73\pm 0.36\,\mathrm{s} for training and 14.21 ± 0.18 ​ s 14.21\pm 0.18\,\mathrm{s} for inference.
Thus, our method has training and inference costs close to MC Dropout under the same T = 5 T=5 sampling setting, with only a small additional overhead from stochastic activation switching.
A five-member Deep Ensemble requires 164.52 ​ s 164.52\,\mathrm{s} for training and 13.27 ​ s 13.27\,\mathrm{s} for inference.
Therefore, our method has a similar multi-pass inference cost to Deep Ensembles while requiring substantially less training and model storage, since only a single trained network is retained instead of five independently trained models.

定型模式需要40.05 s 40.05\,\mathrm{s}一个训练时代和2.83 s 2.83\,\mathrm{s}进行完全的测试设定推论.

因此,在相同的T=5 T=5取样设置下,我们的方法具有接近MC Dropout的培训和推论成本,只有Stochtic活化切换的少量额外间接费用。
五人深集需要164.52 s 164.52\,\mathrm{s}进行训练,13.27 s 13.27\,\mathrm{s}进行推论.

blocks.en: E Corruption Robustness

blocks.en:
We evaluate classification uncertainty under input corruption using CIFAR-10-C with Gaussian noise at severities 1 1 , 3 3 , and 5 5 .
This setting tests whether uncertainty estimates remain meaningful as the input distribution becomes degraded.
Table 11 reports the full uncertainty and calibration results, while Figure 6 visualizes the accuracy degradation.
blocks.zh:
我们用CIFAR-10-C来评估输入腐败的分类不确定性,
这一设定检验了不确定性估计数在投入分布退化时是否仍然有意义。
表11报告了完全的不确定性和校正结果,而图6则可视化了准确性退化.

blocks.en:
Under mild corruption, our method preserves strong predictive accuracy and obtains the best Brier score, indicating that stochastic activation trajectories provide useful uncertainty without strongly affecting the main prediction.
At moderate and severe corruption, MC Dropout achieves the highest accuracy, suggesting that stronger feature removal can act as a noise-robust regularizer under heavy corruption.
However, this robustness comes from explicitly masking activations and therefore removing part of the intermediate representation.
In contrast, our method introduces micro-level stochasticity through activation switching, which keeps the information flow mostly intact while still producing diverse predictions for uncertainty estimation.
As a result, our method remains close to MC Dropout in accuracy while obtaining competitive uncertainty metrics.
At the highest corruption severity, our method achieves the best NLL [ Guo et al.(2017)Guo, Pleiss, Sun, and Weinberger ] and ECE [ Naeini et al.(2015)Naeini, Cooper, and
Hauskrecht ] , while Laplace Redux obtains the best Brier score but with substantially lower accuracy.

在中度和严重的腐败中,MC"退学"达到了最高的准确度,表明更强的特征去除在严重腐败下可以起到噪声-阻塞常态器的作用.
然而,这种稳健性来自明显的遮掩活性活性,并因此去除了部分中间代表.
相比之下,我们的方法通过活化切换引入了微观层次的分光度,它使信息流大多保持完好无损,同时仍然对不确定性估计产生不同的预测.
因此,我们的方法在准确性方面仍然接近于MC的退学,同时获得了竞争性的不确定性衡量标准。
在最高程度的腐败程度上,我们的方法实现了最好的NLL [Guo等人(2017年)Guo、Pleiss、Sun和Weinberger]和欧洲经委会[Naeini等人(2015年)Naeini、Cooper和
Hauskrecht]),而拉普拉斯·雷德克斯则获得最佳布赖尔分数,但准确度却大幅降低.

blocks.en: F OOD Uncertainty Distributions
blocks.zh: FOD 不确定性分布

blocks.en:
To further inspect the OOD behavior of stochastic activation switching, we visualize the distribution of uncertainty scores for ID and OOD samples.
Figure 7 shows that ID samples usually form compact low-uncertainty distributions, while OOD samples shift toward larger and more dispersed uncertainty values.
This indicates that the model remains confident on familiar inputs and becomes less certain when the input distribution changes.
The separation is especially clear for DRIVE → \rightarrow CHASE-DB1, CIFAR-10 → \rightarrow SVHN, and CREMI → \rightarrow ISBI, where OOD samples occupy a broader high-uncertainty range.
For Massachusetts → \rightarrow RoadTracer, the two distributions overlap more strongly because both datasets contain aerial road imagery with similar visual structure; nevertheless, the OOD distribution still shows a wider uncertainty spread.
This supports the quantitative OOD results and shows that stochastic activation trajectories provide an interpretable signal for detecting distribution shift.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步检查Stochastic活化切换的OOD行为,我们直观地呈现ID和OOD样本的不确定性分数分布.
图7显示ID样本通常形成紧凑的低不确定性分布,而OD样本则转向更大更分散的不确定性值.
这表明模型仍然对熟悉的投入充满信心,在投入分配发生变化时变得不那么确定.
对DRIVE → 右倾CHASE-DB1、CIFAR-10 → 右倾SVHN 和 CREMI → 右倾ISBI 来说,这种分离特别明显,其中OD样本占据了更大的高不确定性范围.
对马萨诸塞州 \\ 右旋道追踪器来说,这两个分布更相重叠,因为两个数据集都包含具有类似视觉结构的航空道相图;然而,OD分布仍然显示更大的不确定性分布.
这支持了定量的OD结果,并表明分解活化轨迹为检测分布转移提供了可解释的信号.

blocks.en:
Figure 7: Uncertainty comparison of ID and OOD samples.
ID scores are concentrated at lower uncertainty, while OOD scores are dispersed and shifted toward higher uncertainty.

图7:ID和OD样本的不确定性比较。

blocks.en:
Qualitative OOD segmentation examples are shown in Fig. 8 , where a model trained on CREMI is evaluated on ISBI 2012.
Each row shows the original image, ground-truth mask, prediction, and variance-based uncertainty map.
The uncertainty maps are concentrated around ambiguous membranes, boundary regions, and structures where the stochastic forward passes disagree.
This provides spatial evidence that the model does not only assign a global OOD score, but also localizes where the cross-dataset shift creates uncertainty in the segmentation output.
blocks.zh:
图8显示了定性的OD分解实例,ISBI 2012上评价了一个受过CREMI培训的模型。
每行显示原始图像,地真面具,预测和以差异为基础的不确定性图.
不确定的地图集中在模棱两可的薄膜上,分界区域,以及结构上,而斯多克特前行则有分歧.
这提供了空间证据,证明该模型不仅指定了全球OOD分数,而且将交叉数据集的转变给分解输出带来不确定性的地方定位.
